question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a green ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a red ball, Dave has a teal ball, Eve has a purple ball, Fred has a white ball, and Gertrude has a silver ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Fred and Dave swap balls. Then, Dave and Alice swap balls. Then, Eve and Fred swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap balls. Finally, Dave and Alice swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) green ball
(B) black ball
(C) red ball
(D) teal ball
(E) purple ball
(F) white ball
(G) silver ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: green, black, red, teal, purple, white, silver
1. Claire ↔ Fred: green, black, white, teal, purple, red, silver
2. Bob ↔ Fred: green, red, white, teal, purple, black, silver
3. Fred ↔ Dave: green, red, white, black, purple, teal, silver
4. Dave ↔ Alice: black, red, white, green, purple, teal, silver
5. Eve ↔ Fred: black, red, white, green, teal, purple, silver
6. Gertrude ↔ Alice: silver, red, white, green, teal, purple, black
7. Dave ↔ Alice: green, red, white, silver, teal, purple, black
Bob has the red ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
